Inference Optimization Engineer (Sr Engineer / Sta5 Engineer / Principal Engineer) - India

Full Time
India

Role Overview

This engineering role begins where model training ends. Once a machine learning or large language model (LLM) is trained, an inference optimization engineer figures out how to serve it efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

• Model Compression: Apply techniques like quantization (FP8, INT8, INT4), pruning, and distillation to shrink model size without losing accuracy.

• Runtime & Serving Tuning: Configure and optimize high-throughput serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or Triton Inference Server.
